texts.preamble: Mohammad Fahim Faza Rainy @ Fahim Raza ... vs State Of Maharashtra on 13 November, 2025 2025:Bhc-As:48794 15-Ba-4073- Shivgan In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Bail Application No. 4073 Of 2025 Mohammad Fahim Faza Rainy @ Fahim Raza Rainy ...Applica Versus State Of Maharashtra ... Dated: 13th November 2025 Pc:- 1.
texts.facts: The Applicant seeks his release on bail in connection with FIR No.303 of 2025 dated 19th September 2025 registered with the Naya Nagar Police Station, District: Mira- Bhayandar, Vasai-Virar for the offences punishable under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv), 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 ('BNS'). Page 1 of 5 th 13 November 2025 Mohammad Fahim Faza Rainy @ Fahim Raza ... vs State Of Maharashtra on 13 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35409561/ 1 ::: Uploaded on - 14/11/2025 ::: Downloaded on 15-BA-4073-2025.DOC 2. Mr. Imran Shaikh, learned counsel appearing for the Applicant, submits that the charge-sheet is not yet filed in the Trial Court. Admittedly, the issue pertaining to the said offence, is pending before the Supreme Court. Same are seized by the Investigating Agency.
